package httptransport

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/usecase"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type teacherAssistanceReceiptRepository struct {
	ports.Repository
	instance domain.TaskInstance
	receipt  ports.AssistanceReceipt
	digest   string
}

func (repository *teacherAssistanceReceiptRepository) GetInstance(_ context.Context, studentID, instanceID string) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	if studentID != repository.instance.StudentID || instanceID != repository.instance.ID {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return repository.instance, nil
}
func (repository *teacherAssistanceReceiptRepository) GetAssistance(_ context.Context, studentID, instanceID, usageID string) (ports.AssistanceReceipt, string, error) {
	if studentID != repository.instance.StudentID || instanceID != repository.instance.ID || usageID != repository.receipt.UsageID {
		return ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, "", domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return repository.receipt, repository.digest, nil
}
func (repository *teacherAssistanceReceiptRepository) RecordAssistance(_ context.Context, instance domain.TaskInstance, receipt ports.AssistanceReceipt, digest string) (domain.TaskInstance, ports.AssistanceReceipt, bool, error) {
	if repository.receipt.UsageID != "" {
		if digest != repository.digest {
			return domain.TaskInstance{}, ports.AssistanceReceipt{}, false, domain.ErrIdempotency
		}
		return repository.instance, repository.receipt, false, nil
	}
	repository.instance, repository.receipt, repository.digest = instance, receipt, digest
	return instance, receipt, true, nil
}

func TestTeacherAssistanceResponsePreservesLegacyWireAndStoredReceipt(t *testing.T) {
	const studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	const instanceID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	const usageID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	repository := &teacherAssistanceReceiptRepository{instance: domain.TaskInstance{ID: instanceID, StudentID: studentID, LearningActionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Status: domain.TaskInstanceInProgress, Steps: []domain.Step{{ID: "step-1"}}}}
	occurred := time.Date(2026, 10, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	server := &Server{Runtime: &usecase.Runtime{Repository: repository, Now: func() time.Time { return occurred }}, InternalToken: "runtime-placeholder", TeacherToken: "teacher-placeholder"}
	handler := server.Handler()
	body := `{"usage_id":"` + usageID + `","student_id":"` + studentID + `","assistance":{"schema":"practice-task-assistance-usage.v1","step_id":"step-1","kind":"TEACHER_EXPLANATION"}}`
	requestReceipt := func() *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/task-instances/"+instanceID+"/teacher-assistance", strings.NewReader(body))
		request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-placeholder")
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)
		if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatalf("status=%d response=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
		}
		return response
	}
	first := requestReceipt()
	// This is the strict response contour of the existing Teacher client.
	var legacy struct {
		ID             string    `json:"id"`
		TaskInstanceID string    `json:"task_instance_id"`
		StudentID      string    `json:"student_id"`
		StepID         string    `json:"step_id"`
		Kind           string    `json:"kind"`
		HintLevel      *int      `json:"hint_level,omitempty"`
		PolicyVersion  string    `json:"policy_version"`
		CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(first.Body.Bytes()))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&legacy); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("strict legacy Teacher decoder rejected receipt: %v; response=%s", err, first.Body.String())
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
		t.Fatalf("trailing JSON: %v", err)
	}
	if legacy.ID != usageID || legacy.StudentID != studentID || legacy.TaskInstanceID != instanceID || legacy.StepID != "step-1" || legacy.Kind != "TEACHER_EXPLANATION" || legacy.HintLevel != nil || legacy.PolicyVersion != usecase.AssistancePolicyVersion || !legacy.CreatedAt.Equal(occurred) {
		t.Fatalf("legacy identity drift: %+v", legacy)
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(first.Body.Bytes(), &fields); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"schema", "usage_id", "occurred_at"} {
		if _, ok := fields[forbidden]; ok {
			t.Fatalf("internal receipt field leaked: %s", forbidden)
		}
	}
	if len(fields) != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected legacy field count: %d", len(fields))
	}
	stored := repository.receipt
	persistedJSON, err := json.Marshal(stored)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var persisted map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(persistedJSON, &persisted); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, required := range []string{"schema", "usage_id", "occurred_at"} {
		if _, ok := persisted[required]; !ok {
			t.Fatalf("internal stored receipt changed: missing %s", required)
		}
	}
	if stored.Schema != "practice-task-assistance-usage.v1" || stored.UsageID != usageID || !stored.OccurredAt.Equal(occurred) || !repository.instance.TeacherAssistanceUsed || repository.instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInProgress {
		t.Fatalf("stored receipt or lifecycle changed: %+v", stored)
	}
	second := requestReceipt()
	if !bytes.Equal(first.Body.Bytes(), second.Body.Bytes()) {
		t.Fatalf("duplicate wire receipt changed: first=%s second=%s", first.Body.String(), second.Body.String())
	}
	if repository.receipt != stored {
		t.Fatal("duplicate changed persisted receipt")
	}

}

func TestTeacherAssistanceHintResponsePreservesHintLevel(t *testing.T) {
	const studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	const instanceID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	const usageID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	repository := &teacherAssistanceReceiptRepository{instance: domain.TaskInstance{ID: instanceID, StudentID: studentID, LearningActionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Status: domain.TaskInstanceInProgress, Steps: []domain.Step{{ID: "step-1"}}}}
	occurred := time.Date(2026, 10, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	server := &Server{Runtime: &usecase.Runtime{Repository: repository, Now: func() time.Time { return occurred }}, TeacherToken: "teacher-placeholder"}
	body := `{"usage_id":"` + usageID + `","student_id":"` + studentID + `","assistance":{"schema":"practice-task-assistance-usage.v1","step_id":"step-1","kind":"HINT","hint_level":2}}`
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/task-instances/"+instanceID+"/teacher-assistance", strings.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-placeholder")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	server.Handler().ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d response=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &fields); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(fields) != 8 || string(fields["hint_level"]) != "2" || string(fields["kind"]) != `"HINT"` || string(fields["id"]) != `"`+usageID+`"` {
		t.Fatalf("hint response drift: %s", response.Body.String())
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"schema", "usage_id", "occurred_at"} {
		if _, ok := fields[forbidden]; ok {
			t.Fatalf("internal receipt field leaked: %s", forbidden)
		}
	}
	if repository.receipt.HintLevel != 2 || repository.instance.HintsUsed != 1 || repository.instance.MaxHintLevel == nil || *repository.instance.MaxHintLevel != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("stored hint behavior changed: receipt=%+v instance=%+v", repository.receipt, repository.instance)
	}

}
